summary: Based on the origination 8-K and Q1 2023 10-Q, no new information suggests the existing covenants are inadequate; all clauses are retained, resulting in no material drift.

clauses.rationale: No evidence shows Consolidated Core Assets approaching the $250 M threshold; cash and inventory remain sufficient.
Management’s going‑concern assessment does not indicate an audit exception; the covenant already bars such opinions.
No evidence of issues with monthly financial delivery or compliance certification.
Amazon Break Fee sweep provisions are already reflected in the agreement; no new evidence warrants change.
No evidence of default‑notice problems or need to alter the notice requirement.

drift_reasons: Available evidence (origination 8‑K and Q1 2023 10‑Q) does not show any deterioration that would require tightening, loosening, or adding covenant protections; the existing package remains appropriate.
